# Kshetra Institute of Fine Arts

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Kshetra Institute of Fine Arts?
67/3, Second Floor, 7th Avenue, Annai Velankanni Road, MG Road, Besant Nagar, Chennai.

### What facilities does Kshetra Institute of Fine Arts have?
Bharatanatyam, Carnatic vocal, Veena, Drawing, painting & craft, Classical fusion, Nattuvangam, Weekday batches, Weekend batches, One-to-one classes, Online classes, Arangetram preparation, Workshops.

### Do you offer online classes?
Yes — besides weekday, weekend and one-to-one classes, we teach online.

### Do you prepare students for arangetram?
Yes. Kshetra prepares and helps dance students for their arangetram.

### How do I join Kshetra Institute of Fine Arts?
Pick a date on this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99623 03089.
